notes: ἕνεκεν is classified improper under rule 95 (one case, no verbal compound), so rule 78's settlement heads its for … sake frame on sake rather than on for — the reading rule 78 states in terms for this very lexeme.
ὃς ἐάν and ὃς ἄν are each one aligned unit compressed into whosoever (rules 50, 72), the intervening γάρ standing on its own.
